other_conditions: Must be a permanent resident of Meghalaya
Must have passed 10+2 in the Science stream with Physics, Chemistry, Biology and English as compulsory subjects
General and OBC candidates must have at least 55% aggregate marks in 10+2
SC and ST candidates must have at least 45% aggregate marks in 10+2
Must qualify the ICAR All India Entrance Examination (AIEEA) conducted by NTA
benefits_summary: Sponsorship of seats with a monthly stipend of ₹1,200 and a book grant of ₹1,200 per academic year.
